applicationName.description: Empty = derive from the destination (tabletennis-<sha1[:8]>), so two clusters cannot collide in the management cluster's argocd namespace.

destination.description: Provide `server` (cluster URL) or `name` (registered cluster name) — at least one required. No namespace: the three components live in namespaces of their own, set per component.

syncPolicy.description: Applied to every rendered Application. CreateNamespace=true is required — none of the published bases ships a Namespace.

domain.description: The cluster's domain. Each component's hostname defaults to <component>.<domain>.

gateway.description: Gateway both HTTPRoutes attach to. Keep it internal: zaehlwerk has no authentication, so its route is the access control.

sectionNameHTTP.description: Listener schmetterpause's redirect route attaches to. Getting this wrong loops HTTPS onto itself without failing anything.

secretStore.description: Store both applications' ExternalSecrets read from. Named per cluster (pattern vault-<cluster>), never plain `vault`.

homerun2.description: All this platform knows about homerun2. The namespace derives zaehlwerk's panel URLs and the light-catcher's Redis address; empty means homerun2 is not on this cluster, and then zaehlwerk runs without a panel and lightCatcher.enabled is refused.

values.description: Pass-through onto apps/schmetterpause/install's values, merged over what this chart computes and winning over it. Validated by that chart's own schema.

allowedOrigins.description: Browser origins allowed to read the live match stream. Empty = none; upstream refuses the `*` wildcard.

panel.description: Wire the scoreboard panel from homerun2.namespace. False runs zaehlwerk without one even where homerun2 is present.

values.description: Pass-through onto apps/zaehlwerk/install's values, merged over what this chart computes.

lightCatcher.description: The LED strip at the table: a second light-catcher instance in its own namespace, reading only the tabletennis stream. Runs the homerun2 light-catcher image and reads homerun2's Redis, so homerun2.namespace is required. Needs light-catcher v1.1.0+ (tag matching).

wledEndpoint.description: Where the effects are sent. Empty = homerun2's wled-mock Service. Ignored when profileContent is set.

redisStream.description: Must match the stream omni-pitcher routes `system: tabletennis` onto. Nothing here can check that.

redisPassword.description: Dev-only inline literal. Empty deletes the base's Secret so an ESO-managed one takes over.

profileContent.description: Replaces the whole profile.yaml. Empty = the four built-in tabletennis effects.

secrets.description: ExternalSecret for the light-catcher's Redis password, via apps/homerun2/secrets. Only rendered together with lightCatcher.enabled — schmetterpause and zaehlwerk carry their own ExternalSecrets in their published bases.
